research_pack.summary: IIM Kashipur offers full-time residential MBA and MBA (Analytics) programmes, alongside Executive MBA and Executive MBA (Analytics) programmes. The MBA (Analytics) is a two-year, six-term residential programme featuring core management/analytics courses, electives, a summer internship, and a dissertation. The Executive MBA (Analytics) is a two-year, six-term blended learning programme for working professionals, requiring a bachelor's degree (min 45% marks) and 3 years of full-time work experience. Executive MBA fees total ₹12,00,000 over two years (₹6,60,000 for year one; ₹5,40,000 for year two). The institute facilitates student exchange programmes with various international partner universities. Admissions, selection criteria, and placement details are managed through the institute's academic and placement offices.

Programme About Management Development Programmes Enter your details × Name: Email Moblie Number Organization ↻ Executive education, aimed at enhancing competencies amongst managers and executives working at different levels, is an important constituent of the offerings at IIM Kashipur. These Management development programs(MDPs) are structured keeping in mind the changing global business environment and international standards which help in developing the skills and competencies of the participants. Our programs are designed for Specialised areas like business policy, finance, accounting, organisational behaviour, marketing, industrial and personal relations, quantitative and production methods, information systems and computers, health, public systems, agriculture and education. We offer two types of MDPs: Open MDPs: These programmes are in the nature of 'open-enrolment' courses, usually 2-5 days in duration with participation open to all practicing/experienced managers and/or executives. Customised MDPs: We also offer exclusive custom-designed programmes, to address specific Executive Learning and/or Corporate Training mandates from individual organisations. Under this format, courses are designed in collaboration with the client organisation, and scheduled at a mutually convenient date and venue. Such programmes can be domain-specific as in Sales & Marketing, Operations, Finance, Strategy, Leadership, etc. or inter-disciplinary, involving an optimal mix of multiple functional areas. leaders who can harness the power of analytics to improve organisational processes. The programme trains learners in the emerging and interdisciplinary areas of analytics, technology and management through cross-functional academic and practical learning. The programme boasts a meticulously reverse-engineered curriculum based on industry needs and trends, enabling learners to implement everything they learn in the workplace almost instantaneously. Programme Highlights Comprehensive learning spread across 6 terms over 24 months Flexible curriculum with 40+ electives across 9 domains Robust pedagogy of cases, simulations, workshops & capstone projects Blended learning of online and on-campus classes with faculty & industry experts One-to-one virtual meeting with faculty to exchange opinions IIM Kashipur Alumni Status Evaluations The evaluation of academic performance may be based on the following components: Assignments Quizzes Project Work Term-end Examination Class Participation Industry Workshops Other components decided by the course instructor Certification Participants should acquire 34.5 credits across the six terms. facilitated by the International Relations Committee (IRC). All the participants are required to comply with the guidelines and provide relevant documents as necessary for smooth facilitation of the exchange program. The IRC’s decision is final and binding to the exchange programs in case of any ambiguity. To develop academic and cultural interchanges through mutual assistance in the areas of education and research, IIM Kashipur reinforces its cooperative relations with its ever-increasing partner institutions. IIM Kashipur and its esteemed partners, in a Memorandum of Understanding, decided to cooperate in areas including the programs offered at their institutions through activities or programs relating to business education of the following types: Short-term Exchange of Students; Exchange of Faculty; and Development of Joint Research Activities The following are the partners of IIM Kashipur: Alba Graduate Business School ESDES School of Business and Management Coller School of Management Turiba University Universidad de Lima Solbridge International School of Business Linnaeus University Soochow University International Centre for Promotion of Enterprises (ICPE), Slovenia CTBC Business School Autonomous University of Madrid Brunel University Syracuse University In the flagship student exchange program, students from IIM Kashipur can complete their one trimester in one of the partner university. It aims to send the best of students to its partner institutes, where students are evaluated on several parameters before getting nominated. Also, IIM Kashipur hosts exchange students from its partner institutes, which is culturally and academically immersive program. We also encourage short term exchange program (typically ranges from a week or two) from our partner institutes, which is a bespoke program. IIM Kashipur aims to become an institute of international excellence in the upcoming years. In the journey, it aims to expand its presence via collaborations with prominent institutes around the world. Every collaboration with IIM Kashipur strives to generate value for the students and more importantly society at large. Enter your details × Name: Email Moblie Number Organization ↻ The MBA (Analytics) at IIM Kashipur is a two-year, full-time residential program meticulously crafted to build a strong foundation in both management principles and advanced data analytics. Designed for future leaders in the analytics domain, the curriculum offers a structured and progressive learning journey that seamlessly integrates theoretical frameworks with practical application. First-Year Structure The first year is organized into three academic terms and comprises exclusively mandatory core courses. These courses span key functional areas of management and analytics, equipping students with essential knowledge and skills that serve as the bedrock for advanced study. Upon completion of the first-year coursework, students undertake an 8–10 week summer internship, providing immersive exposure to real-world business challenges and an opportunity to apply classroom learning in a professional environment. Second-Year Structure The second year is divided into three terms (IV, V, and VI) and features a blend of mandatory analytics courses, a diverse selection of electives, and a comprehensive dissertation component. Students have the flexibility to customize their academic path by selecting electives aligned with their interests and career goals. The dissertation, conducted across all three terms of the second year, allows students to engage in deep, independent research on a topic of personal or professional relevance. This capstone project fosters critical thinking and analytical rigor, guiding students through the process of problem definition, application of analytical methodologies, and synthesis of insights—skills that are indispensable in today’s data-centric business landscape. Process EPGDBM Programme Overview Enter your details × Name: Email Moblie Number Organization ↻ The MBA in Business Analytics at IIM Kashipur is a rigorous, two-year, fully residential program meticulously designed for ambitious professionals poised to lead the data-driven transformation of modern enterprises. This program empowers students to become strategic decision-makers by equipping them with the analytical expertise and managerial acumen essential for navigating complex business environments. Through an immersive and interdisciplinary curriculum, the program seamlessly integrates foundational management principles with cutting-edge analytical techniques. Students gain the capability to conduct sophisticated data analyses, uncover actionable insights, and formulate strategies that drive impactful decisions across diverse sectors. The program cultivates future-ready leaders who demonstrate a robust command of management theory, advanced analytical skills, and refined communication abilities. Emphasis is placed on identifying and framing business and societal challenges, applying analytical tools to reveal patterns, and leveraging insights to craft evidence-based solutions. Holistic development is a cornerstone of the MBA in Business Analytics. Students are encouraged to adopt a data-centric mindset and a disciplined approach to decision-making. A wide array of electives enables participants to tailor their academic journey in alignment with personal interests and professional aspirations. The inclusion of a dissertation, spanning three terms in the second year, provides a platform for rigorous research, allowing students to define precise research questions and apply appropriate methodologies—thereby enhancing their analytical and investigative capabilities. IIM Kashipur’s esteemed faculty bring a rich blend of scholarly excellence and industry insight to the classroom. The learning experience is further elevated by contributions from seasoned industry professionals through guest lectures and specialized modules. This dynamic academic environment fosters a deep understanding of theoretical frameworks, practical applications, and strategic perspectives—preparing graduates to thrive in the rapidly evolving domain of business analytics.
